svg.title: Training pipelines for video discriminative and reward models
svg.desc: Three horizontally separated training pipelines. Each row begins with Real and Generated video thumbnails feeding into a CogVideoX Backbone box containing an autoencoder and three transformer-layer blocks. Outputs pass through latent stacks, LoRA adapters, MLP blocks, score/latent icons, and loss terms. Top row includes latent-space perturbations and compressed latents for contrastive loss; middle row trains aspect-wise scores for MSE loss; bottom row adds a linear head for relative-preference BT loss. Symmetry basis: the three rows share a repeated left-to-right pipeline with aligned backbone frames and mostly horizontal flow arrows; unique row-specific heads appear after the MLP block.

g.text: Training the Reward Model on Aspect-Wise Scores
